id: title:Gilbert09:request a clamped window for the org stats summary

review.posthog_relevance: Connects warehouse ingestion to Sentry's retention boundary rejection; avoids 400 errors by not sending a relative period that lands on a boundary, instead sending an absolute clamped window.
review.reason: The P1.F1.H1 hunk implements a production change replacing a rejected API parameter ('statsPeriod') with explicit start and end windows, directly addressing a compatibility issue with Sentry's ingestion endpoint. P1.F2.H1 provides a corresponding unit test. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.uncertainty: The score relies on the assumption that the Sentry API compatibility issue is a genuine production constraint rather than a hypothetical or development-only scenario; no release notes or adoption metrics are available to independently verify the severity or actual impact on users.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a production implementation change. P1.F2.H1 is a test-only change. No relationship between the two is established. No score assigned.
